messages.subject: [Epls-r-users] Meeting Tomorrow
messages.body_plain:
Graphs (or networks), diagrams with nodes and edges, are an important part of many different analyses:  Bayesian networks (my specialty), Structural Equation Models, Social Network Analyses, &c.

We will talk about two different packages in tomorrow's R Group.

Graphviz (which is actually a command line tool for drawing graphs) and DiagrammeR (which calls it from R)

Igraph  which offers a graph data structure for R, several different graph theory functions and some displays as well.

We meet tommorrow (Nov 3) at 12:00 (EDT) either in Stone room 1203 on zoom at https://fsu.zoom.us/j/98649616720.


--
